text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you for giving me some time off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, I was able to take a leisurely stroll through a lush, green area.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, it was a great way to refresh myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I'll be putting my all into training again,
so I'm counting on you.
